subject: literacy
concept: Recalling key details and their order from a short passage
source_inspiration: adapted from Mississippi Science-of-Reading comprehension sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student arranges sequence cards in the correct order after hearing a short passage
exercise.pictorial: Student numbers pictured events from a passage in the order they happened
exercise.abstract: Student answers 'what happened first/next/last' questions about a written passage

misconception_flags: recalls correct details but in the wrong sequence

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
